description: Nvidia’s GeForce Now cloud gaming service has been available globally for a while. It sure makes a solid case for the continued need to invest in expensive gaming hardware for playing games. With the ongoing memory crisis, many could benefit from such a cloud gaming service, which is available in both free and paid tiers. But how does it work in India? We got a chance to try it out and came out impressed.
title: Nvidia GeForce Now for India Hands-On: Built to Impress

description: NASA and SpaceX have delayed the Crew-12 mission to the International Space Station because of unfavorable weather expected at Cape Canaveral. The launch is now targeted for February 12, with four astronauts waiting in quarantine as teams prepare the Falcon 9 rocket and Crew Dragon spacecraft for the next launch window.
title: NASA, SpaceX Delay ISS Mission Launch Due to Bad Weather

description: Scientists analysing NASA’s Magellan radar data have identified signs of a vast underground lava tunnel on Venus. If confirmed, it would be only the second such structure found on the planet, challenging the belief that Venus is geologically inactive and opening new possibilities for studying its volcanic past.
title: Venus May Hide a Vast Underground Tunnel Formed by Ancient Volcanic Eruptions, Scientists Say

description: Embark Studios has announced a new update for Arc Raiders. Update 1.15.0 adds a new Shared Watch event that rewards players for taking on Arc robots in PvE encounters. The update also brings back the Cold Snap map condition and two new cosmetic sets.
title: Arc Raiders' Update 1.15.0 Adds New Event, Map Condition and Cosmetics

description: Here are five of the best laptops under Rs. 70,000 currently available in India. The list includes Dell 16, HP Victus, Asus Vivobook S14, Lenovo IdeaPad Gaming 3, and Moto Book 60 Pro. Most of the models in this list feature high refresh rate displays, latest processors, advanced connectivity options and Windows 11 Home out of the box.
title: Best Laptops Under Rs. 70,000 in India: Dell 16, Asus VivoBook S14 and More

description: A leaked partner notice suggests Realme could increase smartphone prices in India from February 11. The document, shared by a tipster, lists hikes of Rs. 3,000 for the Realme 15 5G and Realme 16 Pro 5G lineups, while the Realme 16 Pro+ 5G series may see a Rs. 4,000 jump. The notice attributes the changes to rising memory and chipset expenses. Realme has not officially announced any price revision so far.
title: Realme 16 Pro, Realme 15 Price in India to Be Hiked From February 11 Due to Rising Component Costs: Report

description: Google is reportedly planning to expand Personal Intelligence to NotebookLM conversations. As per the report, the Mountain View-based tech giant is testing the capability, which allows AI chatbots to seamlessly retrieve data from compatible knowledge hubs to personalise responses, within NotebookLM. If true, this will mark the tech giant’s second expansion of the feature, after it was added to AI Mode in Search last month.
title: Google Is Reportedly Bringing Personal Intelligence to NotebookLM

description: Honor Magic 9 series will be launched by the Chinese smartphone maker with a notable upgrade in the battery department compared to its predecessor, a tipster on Weibo claims. Expected to include two models, one of the phones in the Honor Magic 9 series is tipped to pack an 8,000mAh battery, while the other could be equipped with a 9,000mAh battery. The phones are expected to succeed the Honor Magic 8 and Magic 8 Pro, which were launched in China in October 2025 with 7,000mAh and 7,200mAh batteries, respectively.
title: Honor Magic 9 Series Tipped to Launch With Significant Battery Upgrade Over Magic 8 Models

description: Anthropic’s India expansion plans have reportedly come across an unexpected hurdle. As per the report, the San Francisco-based AI firm is facing a legal complaint from an Indian company named Anthropic Software over brand confusion. The local company reportedly argues that it has been using the name much before Anthropic, and it should get recognition of prior use.
title: Anthropic Sues Anthropic? AI Startup’s India Ambitions Face Legal Challenge Over Brand Confusion: Report

description: Just a week after the software and IT services-led market crash, Databrick CEO has reportedly offered insights into how artificial intelligence (AI) can shape the industry. Last week’s stock sell-off occurred after Anthropic announced new built-in plug-ins for Claude Cowork, an AI-powered automation tool for enterprises. It was said that these plug-ins, which allowed the company’s AI agent to handle software-as-a-service (SaaS) operations without human intervention, created a panic of AI replacing enterprise products among retail investors.
title: Databricks CEO Reportedly Highlights Existential Risk to SaaS Days After IT Market Crash

description: Google Pixel 10a has appeared on e-commerce websites, showing its European pricing and specifications. The listings show the phone in 128GB and 256GB storage options. It is already scheduled to launch on February 18. The Pixel 10a is tipped to come with a 6.3-inch display and Google's Tensor G4 chipset. It could feature a dual rear camera unit led by a 48-megapixel primary camera.
title: Google Pixel 10a Price, RAM and Storage Configurations Revealed via Retail Listings Ahead of February 18 Launch

description: iQOO Z11x and iQOO Z11 have spotted on the China Compulsory Certification (3C) database with V2547A and V2551A model numbers, respectively, according to a tipster. The standard model from the Vivo sub-brand has been listed with a 90W charging adapter, hinting that it might support 90W wired fast charging. Further, the smartphone is said to be equipped with a 9,000mAh battery, a 1.5K resolution LTPS display, and a “mid-range” chipset. Meanwhile, the iQOO Z11x will reportedly feature a 6.76-inch Full-HD+ LCD screen and a Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chip.
title: iQOO Z11, iQOO Z11x Launch Appears Imminent as Both Handsets Visit China’s 3C Certification Database

description: Samsung Galaxy F70e 5G competes with Redmi 15C 5G and Poco C85 5G in India’s budget 5G segment. All three offer large HD+ 120Hz displays and 6,000mAh batteries. Prices start at Rs. 12,499 for Redmi and Poco, while Samsung begins at Rs. 12,999. Samsung provides the longest software support with six years of updates, Redmi adds an IR blaster and faster 33W charging, and Poco offers expandable storage up to 1TB.
title: Samsung Galaxy F70e 5G vs Redmi 15C 5G vs Poco C85 5G: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: WhatsApp is reportedly testing a new feature for its Android app that aims to provide users more control over the appearance of the app. As per details shared by a feature tracker, the Meta-owned instant messaging platform is working on several new visual elements for WhatsApp, enabling customisation of the app theme, icon, and accent colour as per their preference. These plans are expected to be part of the long-rumoured premium plan of the Meta-owned app.
title: WhatsApp for Android Said to Be Testing Custom App Icons and Themes Tied to Premium Subscription

description: Accused is an upcoming psychological thriller film that has been produced under the Dharmatic Productions. The film stars Konkana Sen Sharma and Pratibha Ranna in the lead roles.
title: Accused OTT Release Date Confirmed: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Apple’s next AirPods Pro could include infrared sensors or camera-like modules to detect surroundings, according to a new leak. The claim suggests the earbuds may “see around you” without a price increase over the current Rs. 25,900 model. Reports indicate Apple may use infrared cameras or depth sensors for spatial awareness, improved audio, and AI features, not photo capture.
title: Apple's Next AirPods Pro Model Tipped to Feature Cameras, Could Launch Without Price Hike

description: Honor 600 Lite has been spotted on Geekbench, pointing to a MediaTek Dimensity 7100 processor along with 8GB RAM and Android 16, likely running MagicOS 10. The listing shows scores of 994 in single-core and 3,023 in multi-core performance. The device has also cleared several certifications, confirming features such as 5G, NFC, and eSIM support. Reports also suggest Honor could skip the Honor 500 series in global markets.
title: Honor 600 Lite Runs Geekbench With MediaTek Dimensity 7100 SoC, Android 16

description: Indian Penal Law is a Tamil thriller set in Madurai, revolving around Gunasekaran, a taxi driver who becomes entangled in a false criminal accusation after a corrupt police officer uses his car. As he battles injustice, he faces emotional turmoil, legal pressure, and a quest for truth.
title: Indian Penal Law Streaming Now on Tentkotta: What You Need to Know About This Tamil Thriller Movie?

description: iQOO 15R will be equipped with a 1.5K resolution AMOLED display, which will deliver up to 144Hz of refresh rate, up to 5,000 nits of local peak brightness, and support for HDR10+ content, the company revealed via the phone’s dedicated microsite. The handset will also ship with IP68 + IP69 ratings for dust and water resistance. It will be launched by the smartphone maker with support for Bluetooth 6, Wi-Fi 7, NFC, a USB Type-C port, and an infrared blaster for connectivity. The handset is confirmed to be powered by Qualcomm’s octa core 3nm Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset.
title: iQOO 15R Display Features, IP Ratings and Other Specifications Revealed Ahead of Launch in India

description: Lava Bold N2 will be launched in India soon, as a dedicated microsite for the smartphone is now live in India. The upcoming handset is confirmed to go on sale in the country via Amazon in at least black and silver colour options. The Lava Bold N2 is teased to be equipped with a dual rear camera unit, housed inside a square-shaped camera module. It will carry a 13-megapixel camera on the back, along with an LED flash. It is shown to feature a USB Type-C port and a 3.5mm audio jack for connectivity.
title: Lava Bold N2 India Launch Teased Alongside Design, Colour Options; Amazon Availability Confirmed

description: Mindiyum Paranjum is a light-hearted romance drama film that has been written and directed by Arun Bose. The film is now streaming on Sun NXT.
title: Mindiyum Paranjum Now Streaming on SunNXT: Everything You Need to Know About Cast, Plot, and More

description: OnePlus is providing limited-time offers on its audio products and tablets ahead of Valentine's Day. The sale will run until February 15, 2026. Different tablets incluyuding OnePlus Pad 3, OnePlus Pad Go 2, and OnePlus Pad Go, are available at discounted prices during this period. The OnePlus Bullets Z3, OnePlus Buds Z2 ANC, and OnePlus Nord Buds 3r are also getting discounts as part of the Valentine's Day offers.
title: OnePlus Pad 3, OnePlus Buds Pro 3 and More Go on Sale at Discounted Prices With Valentine’s Day Offers

description: Playground Games has detailed some of the new features coming to Forza Horizon 6. The open world racing game launches on PC and PS5 on May 19, and on PS5 later this year. Forza Horizon 6 is set in Japan and features the biggest open world in franchise history.
title: Playground Games Details New Forza Horizon 6 Features: Car Meets, Seasonal Changes and More

description: Qualcomm announced the Snapdragon X2 Elite processor at the Snapdragon Summit in September 2025, and PCs powered by the chipset are expected to hit the market in the first half of 2026. The new chip has now reportedly surfaced in early benchmarks, with comparisons being made against Apple’s Apple M5 chipset. The leaks suggest that Qualcomm’s next-generation Snapdragon X2 Elite could bring Windows-on-Arm devices closer to Apple Silicon in raw performance metrics.
title: Snapdragon X2 Elite vs Apple M5: Qualcomm's Chip Outdoes Apple Silicon in Multi-Core Benchmarks

description: Written and directed by Nithish Shadev, Thalaivar Thambi Thalaimaiyil is a Tamil comedy-drama film set to land on Netflix soon.
title: Thalaivar Thambi Thalaimaiyil OTT Release: Everything You Need to Know About This Tamil Film

description: Amazon is reportedly planning to launch an artificial intelligence (AI) content marketplace to provide a common ground for publishers and AI developers. As per the report, the project could be headed by the Seattle-based tech giant’s cloud computing division Amazon Web Services (AWS). The project is said to be at the discussion stage currently, and it is unclear how much progress has been made around it.
title: Amazon Ready to Take on Microsoft with AI Content Licensing Hub: Report

description: iPhone 17e is tipped to come with the same hardware features as the iPhone 16e. The only major upgrade could be the presence of Apple’s A19 chip. This would be a notable upgrade over the A18 chip available on the iPhone 16e. Apple is said to be using the same iPhone 16e mold for for the upcoming iPhone 17e, indicating that the design and dimensions of the new model will remain unchanged. The iPhone 17e is tipped to use the same display panel as the iPhone 16e.
title: iPhone 17e Tipped to Launch With One Major Hardware Upgrade; Design Said to Be Identical to iPhone 16e

description: OpenAI might have turned its fortunes this week. As per multiple reports, the company CEO Sam Altman had announced a “code red” in December 2025, asking all employees to focus on improving ChatGPT and related products, while putting everything else on hold. The concentrated effort led to the release of GPT-5.2, adjustable personality traits in ChatGPT, new healthcare features, and a new artificial intelligence (AI) model for Codex.
title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman Teases New ChatGPT Model as Revenue Growth Rebounds: Report

description: Oppo K14x 5G has been launched in India by the Chinese smartphone maker. The new smartphone is the first model to launch as part of the Oppo K14 lineup. The Oppo K14x 5G is scheduled to go on sale in the country on February 16 via Flipkart and the Oppo India online store. It is offered in Icy Blue and Prism Violet colourways. Customers will be able to purchase the phone in 4GB+128GB and 6GB+128GB RAM and storage configurations. It packs a 6,500mAh battery with support for 45W wired fast charging. It is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset.
title: Oppo K14x 5G Launched in India With 6,500mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: The PlayStation 5 (PS5) reached the middle of its life cycle in late 2025, and early development of its purported successor, ubiquitously known as the PlayStation 6 (PS6), is said to already commenced. According to a recent leak, Sony’s next-generation gaming console could feature a notable increase in system memory. The console may ship with up to 30GB of unified memory, marking a substantial jump over both the PS5 and the higher-end PS5 Pro.
title: PS6 Tipped to Feature Up to 30GB of Unified Memory With Higher Bandwidth to Support Next-Gen Features

description: The One UI 8.5 beta 4 is said to be rolling out to Galaxy S25 devices in select regions. The update is around 1.5GB in size and includes the February 5, 2026, security patch. It fixes problems related to search history in the Phone app and Bluetooth headset call switching. The Android 16-based update also brings a Direct Voicemail feature for the Galaxy S25 series. The update seems to be available for users enrolled in the beta programme.
title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Series Owners Can Now Install One UI 8.5 Beta 4 in Select Regions

description: Sony has announced a State of Play broadcast for this week, featuring trailers and updates on games from first and third-party studios. The event will be livestreamed on February 12. The upcoming State of Play is one of the longest ever with over 60 minutes of news and updates on upcoming games on PS5.
title: Sony Announces Hour-Long State of Play Broadcast for This Week: What to Expect

description: An Anthropic executive’s resignation has gone viral on the Internet. On Monday, Mrinak Sharma, who led the company’s Safeguards Research Team, shared a post on his social media handle, mentioning that it was his last day at Anthropic. Alongside the post, the former artificial intelligence (AI) safety lead also shared a long letter that he said was shared with his colleagues to explain the reason behind the departure.
title: Anthropic’s AI Safety Lead Mrinak Sharma Resigns, Shares Letter Explaining Why

description: DuckDuckGo has launched an opt-in real-time voice chat feature for its Duck.ai AI chatbot, allowing users to speak to the assistant instead of typing. The company said voice mode can be enabled or disabled anytime and does not require an account, though daily usage limits apply, with higher caps for subscribers. Voice sessions connect to an OpenAI model through an encrypted relay, with audio streamed live for transcription and responses. DuckDuckGo said recordings are not stored or used for training.
title: DuckDuckGo Updates Duck.ai Platform With Real-Time AI Voice Conversations

description: OpenAI announced on Monday that it has begun testing ads in ChatGPT. The Sam Altman-led tech firm highlighted that the ads are currently being displayed only in the US, and will later be rolled out in other regions to free users and Go subscribers. The company claims that the platform will not share the conversations and interactions of users with the advertisers. However, OpenAI did highlight that ChatGPT will display ads based on a user's prompts and the history of conversation.
title: OpenAI Starts Showing Ads to ChatGPT Free and ChatGPT Go Subscribers in the US

description: Qualcomm’s next-generation flagship phone chipset will be “extremely expensive”, according to a tipster. Expected to be named Snapdragon 8 Gen 6 Pro, the SoC will reportedly be built on a 2nm TSMC process, the same as the standard model, which could be marketed as the Snapdragon 8 Gen 6. The Snapdragon 8 Gen 6 Pro SoC is expected to power the rumoured Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra, which might launch next year. The expected price increase suggests that the smartphone could also be launched with a higher price tag.
title: Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Gen 6 Pro Chipset to Have ‘Extremely’ High Price Tag, Tipster Claims

description: Discord will begin a global rollout of age verification in early March for users seeking full access to the platform. Teen-focused safety and communication controls will be applied by default across all accounts. Users may need to verify their age to view sensitive material, enter age-restricted spaces, or adjust messaging settings. Discord said age checks can be completed through on-device facial estimation or by submitting identification to vendor partners. The company will also use an age inference model, alongside tighter content filters and a new Teen Council.
title: Discord's Global Age Verification for Full Feature Access Will Roll Out in March; Company to Create Teen Council

description: Samsung may have inadvertently hinted at when it plans to unveil its next flagship smartphones, expected to launch as the Galaxy S26 series. According to a recent report, the South Korean tech conglomerate has hinted at when it plans to unveil the Galaxy S26 family during a campaign’s announcement through its official social media handle. The Samsung Galaxy S26 series is expected to be introduced towards the end of February, corroborating previous leaks about the launch timeline.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Launch Date Leaked via Official Campaign Announcement

description: WhatsApp Web is reportedly getting voice and video calling support. The long-awaited feature is currently available to select beta users for one-to-one chats, and this could be available for more users in the coming weeks. The update adds end-to-end encrypted calls and screen-sharing support to WhatsApp Web. Currently, WhatsApp allow Web users to send text messages and share media, while voice and video calling remain exclusive to desktop apps.
title: WhatsApp Web Finally Introduces Support for Voice and Video Calls for Some Users: Report

description: Meta is said to be developing a new standalone app that is expected to rival Snapchat in terms of ephemeral communication. According to a report, the company confirmed that an internal prototype of the app, dubbed Instants, is in development that would allow users to send and receive disappearing photos and videos. The Meta-owned social media platform is reportedly also developing a new feature for Instagram with the same name and similar functionality.
title: Instagram to Reportedly Rival Snapchat With New ‘Instants’ App for Sending Disappearing Photos

description: Nuuk’s Ren Pro cordless vacuum cleaner checks a lot of boxes for a first time vacuum buyer. The brand raises the bar for a mid-range vacuum cleaner by offering a unique mix of a smart and practical design, covering the basics when it comes to features, and goes over and above when it comes to tools and overall quality.
title: Nuuk Ren Pro Vacuum Review: Power-Packed Performance at an Attractive Price

description: The Tecno Pova Curve 2 5G is scheduled to be launched in India soon as the successor to the Pova Curve 5G, which was introduced in May 2025. The company has teased several details about the handset in the days leading up to its launch. It is confirmed to feature a Space 2.0 design with futuristic design elements. The Tecno Pova Curve 2 5G will be offered in three colour options, featuring a slim 7.4mm profile.
title: Tecno Pova Curve 2 5G Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Price in India, Specifications, Features and More

description: Oppo K14x 5G will be launched in India today at 12pm local time by the Chinese smartphone maker as the latest addition to its smartphone lineup. The phone is set to go on sale in the country via Flipkart and the Oppo India online store. The handset will be offered in Prism Violet and Ice Blue colour options. The upcoming Oppo K14x 5G is confirmed to be equipped with a 6,500mAh battery. The phone will also feature 45W wired fast charging support. It will also be powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset.
title: Oppo K14x 5G Launching Today: Know Price in India, Features, Specifications and More
